content.text: {"summary":"Metrics show no clear degradation in the window: gateway p95 averaged 171ms (max 222ms), with zero 5xx on gateway, orders and inventory and no latency onset detected. Only one slow checkout trace was sampled (1.16s, most self time in orders POST, 477ms). The evidence does not support a root cause.","root_cause":null,"contributing_factors":[{"statement":"A single sampled slow checkout trace at 06:32:23 took 1.16s and returned 201. The largest self time in that trace was in orders POST (477ms). This is one trace and does not establish a pattern.","evidence_ids":["ev-c5c1d6442ba3"]},{"statement":"Orders p95 latency peaked at 167ms against a 108ms average. That suggests some variability in orders, but it stays well under the 1.16s seen in the single slow trace.","evidence_ids":["ev-e92d01f89f8e"]}],"timeline":[{"time":"2026-10-23T05:49:46Z","event":"inventory deployed 3.1.5 -> 9.9.11","evidence_ids":["ev-d345f6171cc0"]},{"time":"2026-10-23T05:50:19Z","event":"inventory rolled back 9.9.11 -> 3.1.5, about 33s later","evidence_ids":["ev-d9852a2bb675"]},{"time":"2026-10-23T06:32:23Z","event":"Slow checkout trace observed (1.16s). Most of the self time was in orders POST.","evidence_ids":["ev-c5c1d6442ba3"]}],"ruled_out":[{"statement":"The inventory 9.9.11 deploy is unlikely to be the cause. It was rolled back to 3.1.5 about 33s later, roughly 42 minutes before the window. The slow trace ran on inventory=3.1.5, and inventory p95 stayed flat at about 45ms.","evidence_ids":["ev-d345f6171cc0","ev-d9852a2bb675","ev-c5c1d6442ba3","ev-bb9d42cefd95"]},{"statement":"Errors are not the issue.
